frozen_before: Any scoring of the second external eight-website holdout
metric_unit: Full-parser canonical URL retrieval within each frozen source scope, aggregated separately per cohort
required_cohorts: first external eight websites: now disclosed regression data
second external eight websites: new heldout evaluation after prior cohorts pass
selection_rule: No net micro-F1 regression and at most two percentage points of precision or recall loss in every required cohort. Report every source and source-macro F1 separately; do not pool cohorts to conceal failures.
execution_order: Original validation and first external regression must pass before new external holdout scoring. Failed gates stop promotion, retain artifacts/results, and do not permit a claim of deployment readiness.
inference_contract: Group refinement operates on a whole listing page. Scalar inference may differ from full-page inference because it lacks peer evidence. Missing source fields mean one page per batch; populated source fields partition mixed-page evaluation batches.
test_protection: No new model fits, threshold changes, grouping changes, or candidate selection may use the second external holdout. Any further iteration must treat evaluated holdouts as disclosed regression data and freeze a new external evaluation.
